description_en: Queries the asset owner account of a protected object in a multi-account management feature scenario
description_zh: 多账号统一管理场景中，用于查询防护对象的资产归属账号
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-defense-resource-owner-uid --instance-id waf_v2_public_cn0000000060f --resource-names a.com-waf,b.com-waf --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDefenseResourceOwnerUid

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The protected objects to query. Separate multiple protected objects with commas (,). A maximum of 100 protected objects can be queried in a single request
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的防护对象，多个防护对象用逗号（,）隔开，单次查询的防护对象个数最多支持100个
parameters.name: resource_names

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
